definition.name: Positive cache · clamp to record expiry

behavior.source: exact same-owner authoritative source database as resolve
behavior.population: Resolver reads and fills its own projection; source access read, cache access read-write. Cache is internal record storage, never an HTTP response cache.
behavior.deadlines: Start one monotonic 1200ms deadline at request acceptance, covering validation, cache read, primary lookup, optional fill and response decision; never reset it. Each operation is capped by min(its phase cap, remaining total time). No operation starts with no budget. Primary admission is immediate: at most64 actual in-flight primary resolve calls shared across all resolve bindings per runtime instance, no unbounded wait/queue, no retries. A timed-out primary call retains its slot until cancellation/completion is confirmed; timeout does not free an ongoing call.
behavior.admission: No primary slot returns overloaded503 immediately after a cache miss/failure. Total deadline or primary phase deadline failure is dependency-failure503, never unknown404.
behavior.record: Validate the closed record schema, canonical requested code equality, normalized HTTP(S) destination without credentials and supported normalized UTC-millisecond expiry before using a hit. Malformed/unsupported records are cache failures and fall back within budget. Only a trusted namespace-isolated cache may supply records; schema validation alone does not authenticate a poisoned payload.
behavior.expiry: Wall-clock UTC decides expiresAt <= now; monotonic time measures deadlines. Recheck wall-clock expiry on every validated hit and immediately before a redirect decision. Expired positive records yield410 and never redirect. A nonexpiring record uses null.
behavior.fill: At the actual write instant, set absolute cache expiry no later than min(write wall-clock +300s, record expiresAt), omitting the second bound for null. Skip nonpositive remaining life. Atomically write value+expiry, never round expiry upward or refresh beyond record expiry. Validate again before redirect; expiry crossed during fill returns410.
behavior.failure: Miss, loss, outage or malformed cache payload falls back once to primary within the same deadline. No negative cache, stale-on-error serving or in-process L1. A validated unexpired cache hit may succeed without primary. Primary outage/timeout/unknown result yields503, never404.
behavior.fillFailure: Fill is optional: skip if insufficient remaining budget and bound it by min(50ms, remaining budget with time reserved for the response decision). Cache fill failure cannot replace a timely authoritative success. Immediately before any response decision, an exhausted total deadline yields dependency-failure503, including after fill; otherwise an ordinary fill failure or skip preserves authoritative success. Never await fill beyond the response deadline; bounded adapter cancellation/completion is future evidence.
behavior.clockEvidence: Finite intent only: synchronized wall-clock/skew handling, monotonic deadline propagation, cancellation, absolute-expiry precision, trusted cache isolation and real-adapter concurrency remain unavailable runtime evidence.

sourceReview.meaning: Sources inform expiration and primary visibility; bounds and clamp policy are application choices, with no selected runtime adapter.
